I have completed the assessment of the repository to identify discrepancies between the documented API specification ([docs/api.md](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-CpSwiE/workspace/docs/api.md)) and the actual codebase implementation ([src/api.js](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-CpSwiE/workspace/src/api.js) & [src/limit.js](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-CpSwiE/workspace/src/limit.js)). The report has been written to [ASSESSMENT.md](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-CpSwiE/workspace/ASSESSMENT.md).

### Summary of Key Findings
- **API Versioning**: `docs/api.md` specifies `/v1/events`, but `src/api.js` serves `/v2/events`.
- **Pagination**: Documented as page-based offset (`?page=2`, 50 items/page); implemented as cursor-based (`?after=<id>`, 25 items/page) returning `{ events, nextCursor }`.
- **POST Behavior**: Implemented logic requires an undocumented `idempotency-key` header (returns HTTP 400 if missing), responds with HTTP `202 Accepted` instead of HTTP `201 Created`, and returns `{ accepted: true }` instead of the created event body.
- **Authentication**: `docs/api.md` claims a mandatory Bearer token in the `Authorization` header returning HTTP `401`, but `src/api.js` does not check for or enforce authentication headers.
- **Rate Limiting**: Documented as 100 requests/min per token; implemented as 600 requests/min per IP (`req.ip`).
